cta.title: Contact Us for Environmental Consulting
cta.text: We are here to help you achieve the best environmental outcomes. Contact us today to see how we can support your projects and strengthen your commitment to sustainability.

footer.about: Alroaa Natural Trading Company — innovative environmental solutions improving quality of life in line with Saudi Vision 2030.

hero.title: Grow your skills. Build lasting impact.

services.title: Environmental solutions and services for companies

why.title: Experts in environment and sustainable development
why.text: Our team of experts and consultants spans many fields of environment and sustainable development, with more than 25 years of accumulated experience.

about.title: About Us
about.sub: A deep understanding of environmental culture in the Kingdom and sustainable planning for environmental challenges.
about.p1: Alroaa Natural Trading Company is guided by a deep understanding of environmental culture in Saudi Arabia, sustainable planning to meet environmental challenges, and scientific contribution to environmental solutions serving society within a civilized vision.
about.p2: We recognize the importance of young national talent and work to develop it and involve it in decision-making, by hiring outstanding environmental experts, developing their skills and delivering services that earn client satisfaction.
about.p3: Our clients’ trust comes first. Building communication bridges and delivering consulting at a level worthy of our clients is a priority we take pride in, out of respect for their opinions and a commitment to meeting their needs with quality and credibility.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: Providing specialized environmental consulting based on scientific knowledge and innovation to support sustainability and protect natural resources, while complying with local and international environmental laws and keeping pace with their continuous updates.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To be the preferred choice in environmental consulting, with innovative solutions that improve environmental quality and resource sustainability locally and regionally, enhancing quality of life in line with Saudi Vision 2030.

services.title: Our Services
services.sub: We offer a wide range of specialized environmental services, chiefly the following.

records.title: Environmental Records
records.text: Issuing and updating environmental records for all types of activities, ensuring compliance.

audit.title: Environmental Audit
audit.text: Environmental audit studies for activities with environmental impact.

mgmt.title: Environmental Management
mgmt.text: Consulting and supervision of environmental management plans.

permits.title: Permits & Licenses
permits.text: Meeting requirements to obtain and renew environmental permits and licenses from the relevant authorities.

rehab.title: Rehabilitation & Remediation
rehab.text: Preparing rehabilitation plans for contaminated sites, supervising implementation and assessing results.

plans.title: Environmental Plans & Programs
plans.text: Plans and programs that reduce the negative impacts of activities affecting the environment.

social.title: Environmental & Social Assessment
social.text: Assessing the environmental, social and cultural factors of activities with environmental impact.

tests.title: Testing & Analysis
tests.text: Supervising scientific testing of environmental samples to detect pollutants and change indicators against local and international standards.

clients.title: Success Partners
clients.sub: Our clients’ trust comes first, and building bridges of communication is our priority.

items.veg: National Center for Vegetation Cover & Combating Desertification

quality.title: Quality
quality.text: We deliver consulting and services to the highest quality standards.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.text: We adopt innovative approaches to environmental challenges.

dedication.title: Dedication
dedication.text: We work with sincerity and professionalism to deliver the best results.

commitment.title: Commitment
commitment.text: We commit to environmental solutions aligned with top global standards.

goals.g1: Comprehensive environmental consulting that supports sustainable development and conserves natural resources
goals.g2: Strengthening partnerships with government and private entities to achieve shared environmental goals

goals.g6: Continuously developing our team and keeping pace with environmental advances to ensure professional excellence
